    invalid reference 
    lastOnline

    LegacyApplicationCsvService
    Imports the legacy PHP TA application's CSV export into a TA recruitment, one application per row, "as if" each student had entered it, so their next application can be pre-filled from it.

    What an upload did; problems names each skipped row and why, and addedTopics the knowledge topics that were not on the TA topics list and were added to it.

    Imports the ULA application Google Form's response sheet, downloaded as CSV, into a ULA recruitment, one application per row, "as if" each student had entered it, so their next application can be pre-filled from it (issue #70).

    What an upload did, and what it added to the ULA topics and interests lists.

    OpenAPIConfig
    The `OpenAPIConfig` class is annotated with OpenAPI definitions including information about the API and server configuration.
    OtherCampusJob
    Whether a ULA applicant will hold another UC job in the same quarter; asked so the hiring paperwork can be planned, never used to decide the application.
    PopulateCoursesJob
    Walks a range of quarters, asking the UCSB API which courses in the configured subject area were offered at the given level, and upserts them into the courses table.
    PopulateCoursesJobFactory
    Builds PopulateCoursesJob instances with their collaborators wired in, so the controller only has to supply the quarter range and level.
    PopulateRecruitmentCoursesJob
    Fills a recruitment's course list: every primary section, of every course flagged for this recruitment's type, that is actually offered in its quarter.
    PopulateRecruitmentCoursesJobFactory
    Wires collaborators into PopulateRecruitmentCoursesJob, as PopulateCoursesJobFactory does.
    PriorCoursework
    One course an applicant has taken, listed on their application as relevant background.
    Quarter
    A UCSB quarter in YYYYQ format, where Q is 1=Winter, 2=Spring, 3=Summer, 4=Fall.
    QuarterCalendarController
    One quarter of the UCSB quarter calendar on file, for any signed-in user (issue #153): the application form fills the notices text's quarter fields (${firstDayOfClasses} and the like) from it.
    RankingsCsvService
    A historical snapshot of faculty rankings, not just currently offered courses.
    Recruitment
    A hiring round for one quarter and one type of position.
    RecruitmentAuditService
    Writes the audit trail of changes to recruitments themselves (issue #139): a row when one is created, a row when one is deleted, and a row per field that changed when one is edited, opened or closed.
    RecruitmentAuditService.Snapshot
    A recruitment's audited fields as strings, keyed by field name; a null field is null.
    RecruitmentAuditTrail
    One change to a recruitment itself (issue #139): its creation, its deletion, or one field going from one value to another, with the value before and after as strings.
    RecruitmentAuditTrailController
    The audit trail of changes to recruitments themselves, read-only, one recruitment at a time (issue #139).
    RecruitmentAuditTrailController.RecruitmentAuditTrailPageDTO
    One page of the trail, in the shape the Audit Trail and Users pages already consume.
    RecruitmentAuditTrailRepository
    The audit trail of changes to recruitments themselves (issue #139).
